parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  o.id,
  o."orderNumber",
  o.status,
  o."paymentMethod",
  o.subtotal,
  o.tax,
  o."totalUsd",
  o."totalVes",
  o."exchangeRate",
  o."shippingAddress",
  o."billingInfo",
  o."expiresAt",
  o."createdAt",
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'speciesName', i."speciesName",
    'size', i.size,
    'quantity', i.quantity,
    'unitPrice', i."unitPrice"
  )) as items
FROM "Order" o
LEFT JOIN "OrderItem" i ON o.id = i."orderId"
WHERE o.id = '{{ $json.body.orderId }}'
GROUP BY o.id;
